proposals.evidence: DEDR705 explicitly gives the widespread uḷḷi/ulli onion family, including Gondi ulli, Konda uli and southern uḷḷi. Survey ulli/uḷḷi/ul onion are direct lexical comparisons; the article also compares Sanskrit ūlī and Oriya uli, but does not specify an immediate borrowing route for these records. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
